verdict.rationale: The evidence describes running and serving local models only. Downloads, the local server, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and headless llmster all handle local inference; none document connecting to external cloud AI providers in the same interface. The Bionic line about 'frontier open models' never says these run through a cloud provider, and the Anthropic-compatible endpoint is something LM Studio serves, not a client connection to Anthropic.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
